name: bett3r-routine
description: The unattended implementation lane a Blueprint routine runs. The design arrives already agreed as the board's blueprint.md, so the lane is plan → build → verify with no /start or /design: /implement cuts the claude/ work branch, /routine-plan slices blueprint.md, the core /build drives the slices, /routine-verify checks the whole change without opening a PR, and one git trailer tells Blueprint done or needs-human. Requires bett3r-ai-workflow, whose /build, agents, skills and bin it calls.
